meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把杂乱难懂的代码拆解重组成清晰结构,让它更易读易改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有写乱或过时的代码想理清结构又不想改变行为
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code into a clearer structure without changing what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your code feels tangled and you want cleaner structure without behavior changes

howto.what: 运行 /refactor 后,Claude 会先与你确认重构目标、范围与验收标准,分析代码库依赖和测试覆盖,再给出分步计划并逐步改代码,每步跑测试与诊断,最后做整体回归检查。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化或提取代码时触发,典型入口是输入 /refactor <重构目标>,并可附加范围、策略等参数。

say.note: 对指定文件走完整重构流程

say.text: /refactor 把校验逻辑抽成独立模块 --strategy=safe

howto.what_en: Running /refactor makes Claude confirm the goal, scope and success criteria, analyze dependencies and test coverage, produce a step-by-step plan, then apply changes step by step with tests and diagnostics after each step and a final regression check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract or modernize code, typically via /refactor <target>, optionally with scope and strategy options.

say_en.note: Runs the full refactor flow on that file
Refactors the class at module scope
Extracts logic under the safe strategy
